set.body: Add the computational, non-plotting volume-to-surface bridge: white/pial surface pair sampling, surfaceToWorld plus NeuroSpace coordinate transforms, midpoint/thickness/normal-line sampling descriptors, nearest/average/mode aggregation, and reusable sampler object. Acceptance: API is pure/inspectable before execution, handles masks and empty voxel sets clearly, preserves old midpoint semantics as a named policy, and tests use synthetic NeuroVol fixtures. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/sampling, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface, modules/image only if a lower-level helper must move.
set.title: Volume-to-surface sampling API
